entries.title: Decoupled Practice Portal & Test Builder into Dedicated Pages
changes: Extracted Practice Mode and Test Builder into dedicated pages (practice.html and test-builder.html) to keep index.html lean and fast.
Streamlined index.html down to a focused CBT Mock Exam simulator.
Unified cross-page navigation with seamless session state and automatic backwards-compatible routing.

entries.title: Custom Test Builder & Build Sheets Generator
changes: Added Custom Test Builder: pick chapters across Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, question count, and exam pattern (JEE Advanced / JEE Main).
Generates clean printable sheets in the exact same format as build_sheets (A4 layout, double navy rules, Q margin labels, 5-pair Answer Key grid, worked Solutions).
Automated FIITJEE watermark and footer banner removal across generated sheets and practice portal.
One-click print/PDF export and direct launch into online CBT practice test mode.

entries.title: Test Submission & Answer Key Repairs
changes: Fixed test submission freeze bug and review renderer error.
Audited and repaired shifted numerical answer keys across 2017-2019 AITS papers.
Updated Maths and Chemistry Advanced question banks with verified keys.

entries.title: Question Reporting
changes: Added Report Question button to flag incorrect answer keys, typos, or cropped images during tests or reviews.

entries.title: PDF Download of Chemistry Questions
changes: Downloads of Chemistry Question are available (printable format)
Reformatted downloads page

entries.title: Mistakes and Bookmarked questions
changes: Added option to view mistakes and saved questions (star button in tests and review)
Added option to import/export your saved questions and question attempted history (it's good to keep a backup of your data once in a while)

entries.title: Seen-question tracking and multi-subject tests and question addition
changes: Added Chemistry Questions (Primarily Advanced).
Physics JEEM AITS Questions added.
Pick Physics, Chemistry or both in one test.
Questions you have already seen are remembered and new ones are shown first (All data is stored locally on your browser, clearing site data will erase it.).

entries.title: PDF Review Download
changes: Adds the ability to save the test you took as a PDF, which includes a summary, and question wise analysis.
